name: Deepwarden

attributes.description:
The old wardens set their oath into its steel.

Swordguard: 12% chance on a successful normal weapon attack to ready a guard for 4 seconds. The next ordinary melee physical hit taken is reduced by 50%, up to 16 HP against creatures or 8 against players. Cooldown: 12 seconds.
Legendary weapon cooldowns are shared by your character. Extra damage is based on the original attack before critical bonuses and mitigation; armor, resistance and player damage rules still apply.
